look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson nine
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 2, lesson T09, Fees, Spread and Slippage; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: A tiny win?
scenes.desc: A small trade shows +0.80 USDT on the chart; three cost tags appear: fees, spread, slippage.

scenes.name: Trading fees
scenes.desc: Fee defined as a percentage of position value; 600 USDT at 0.05% costs 0.30 USDT on entry and on exit.

scenes.name: Maker and taker
scenes.desc: A taker order fills at once against the book; a maker order rests in it; example rates 0.05% and 0.02%.

scenes.name: Spread
scenes.desc: Best ask 60,005 and best bid 59,995: buying and selling at once loses the 10 USDT spread, 0.10 USDT on 0.01 BTC.

scenes.name: Slippage
scenes.desc: Expected and actual fill prices on entry and exit: 10 worse each way, 0.20 USDT on 0.01 BTC.

scenes.name: Funding
scenes.desc: Funding passes between longs and shorts each funding time; 0.01% on 600 USDT is 0.06 USDT.

scenes.name: Add it up
scenes.desc: A waterfall: chart gain +0.80, minus spread, slippage and fees, ends at a net −0.10 USDT.

scenes.name: Break-even move
scenes.desc: Price must rise about 90 USDT per BTC (0.15%) before the trade makes anything; the net meter crosses zero.

scenes.name: Common mistake
scenes.desc: Twenty small trades stack 0.60 USDT of fees each into 12 USDT.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: Pause and work out gross and net for a small trade; the answer +0.40 gross, −0.20 net is revealed.

scenes.name: Check first
scenes.desc: A checklist of real costs ticks through; if the expected move is below break-even, NO_TRADE.

scenes.name: Know the limits
scenes.desc: A model with example numbers; real rates vary; fees on full position value; slippage grows in fast markets.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and one question to check yourself.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: Phase 2 complete; next lesson T10, exchange platform tour.
